title: The Devil and Mr. O
identity_notes: Arch Oboler-hosted syndicated revival/repackaging of earlier Oboler radio plays, chiefly Lights Out material. The frozen GRH set is a clean 26-week Friday sequence from Sep. 17, 1971 through Mar. 10, 1972; Library of Congress archival description documents a broader 1971-73 Devil and Mr. O series context.
